summary: Provisional credit reversed mid-cycle triggering auto-pay hold and invoice negative balance
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that a provisional credit previously issued for hourly smoothing was reversed automatically during an overnight billing run, causing the account to show a negative invoice balance and triggering an automatic payment hold. Impact: Customer's Dedicated cluster entered payment-hold state; API keys temporarily restricted for production org; integrations degraded for live workflows (affects availability of model endpoints).

Environment: prod-us-east (dedicated pool: acme-dedicated-us-east-01).

Observed timeline: 2026-03-10 22:14 UTC - provisional credit issued by support (REF: PC-4431). 2026-03-11 02:07 UTC - automated hourly reconciler job executed. 2026-03-11 02:09 UTC - customer invoice line shows credit reversal of same amount as PC-4431. 2026-03-11 03:30 UTC - autopay hold and email to finance.

Expected: provisional credit remains applied until manual expiry or explicit reversal. Actual: automated process reversed the credit and generated a negative balance/invoice hold.

Customer asks: 1) immediate provisional balance correction to lift autopay hold, 2) explanation for why provisional credit was reversed automatically, 3) assurance this will not recur.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Issue provisional credit to a dedicated customer account via support tool (use support UI or API). 2) Wait for next hourly postback/reconciler window. 3) Observe that credit is potentially included in reconciliation and reversed. 4) Invoice shows negative balance and account may be flagged for autopay hold based on finance thresholds.
logs: billing.reconciler: WARN 2026-03-11T02:08:03Z detected multiple postbacks for org_id=acme-health-org (sources: postback-v1, postback-legacy)
accounting.service: INFO 2026-03-11T02:08:41Z provisional_credit_reversal: credit_id=PC-4431 amount=125.00 currency=USD reason=duplicate_credit_detected by rule=postback-dedup-v0.9
finance.automation: INFO 2026-03-11T03:30:02Z autopay_hold applied for org acme-health-org due_to negative_balance -125.00
investigation_notes: Support initial triage 2026-03-12: validated invoice lines and provisional credit record PC-4431; saw matching reversal recorded by accounting.service during reconciliation run.

Billing engineer 2026-03-12: reconciler flagged duplicate postbacks for the same usage window; dedup rule matched a previously-applied provisional credit and treated it as a duplicate credit and reversed it. Suspect: postback source tagging changed during a staging->prod key rotation, causing reconciler to think postback originated from different source.

SRE 2026-03-12: identified recent deployment of postback-dedup-v0.9 that tightened signature matching (commit 9f2c4a) and did not account for legacy postback source aliases; reproduces reversal when alias present.
Finance 2026-03-12: autopay hold is automated based on negative balance threshold; manual override possible but requires billing team's approval for >$100 adjustments.

Hypothesis: Combined effect of (a) support-issued provisional credit PC-4431, (b) simultaneous legacy and v1 postbacks from dedicated scheduler, and (c) dedup rule treating the credit postback as a duplicated credit, leading to automated reversal during reconciliation run.
comments: Anita Roy (Support) 2026-03-12: Customer contacted via phone; requested provisional fix to lift autopay hold ASAP. Provided account and invoice IDs. Escalated to Billing.

Diego Morales (Billing) 2026-03-12: I'm pulling reconciliation logs and the accounting audit trail. Placing a manual provisional credit of $125.00 to offset immediate negative balance while we investigate root cause. Will document action and link to ticket.

Marta Li (SRE) 2026-03-12: Identified the postback alias discrepancy in the reconciler's matching layer. Opening INT-4421 to track a patch to accept legacy alias mapping. Patch planned for 2026-03-13 morning canary.
Customer (James Patel, Acme Health) 2026-03-12: Thanks, support. Can you confirm endpoints were not throttled during this window? We're concerned about production impact.

Diego Morales (Billing) 2026-03-13: Manual provisional credit applied and autopay hold cleared at 2026-03-13T09:15Z. Confirmed no throttling rules were triggered by this action; keys restored at 09:20Z. Will follow up with permanent fix schedule.
resolution_notes: Temporary action: manual provisional credit of $125.00 applied on 2026-03-13 to restore positive balance and cleared autopay hold; customer notified and keys restored. Root cause: reconciler deduplication rule (postback-dedup-v0.9) incorrectly matched postback source aliases and treated a support-issued provisional credit as duplicate, triggering automated reversal. Permanent fix: SRE/Billing to patch reconciler signature matching to accept legacy alias mapping (INT-4421) and add explicit exclusion list for support-issued provisional credits. Deploy planned 2026-03-13 canary, full rollout 2026-03-14 after validation. Follow-ups: update runbook and add alert on "provisional_credit_reversal" audit events, create playbook for rapid manual override under finance thresholds. Customer compensation: offering one-week credit on next invoice as goodwill (pending approval).
next_steps: INT-4421: apply reconciler patch to accept legacy postback aliases (SRE) - target canary 2026-03-13
Billing: add provisional-credit exclusion to dedup rules, add unit tests to prevent future false positives
Support: confirm customer receives goodwill credit and close loop after full rollout
Finance: review autopay hold thresholds for dedicated customers and allow emergency small-amount overrides via billing rotation
